Title: Stream Analytics offers native support for Parquet format

Body.Content: Azure Stream Analytics now offers native support for Apache Parquet format when writing to Azure Blob storage or Azure Data Lake Storage Gen 2. Apache Parquet is a columnar storage format tailored for bulk processing and query processing in the Big Data ecosystems. More detailed information can be found in our output adapters documentation.
